vocabulary.meaning_en: a two- or three-word verb: a verb + a preposition/particle (pick up, keep up)
a small word like up, on, in, at that shows place, direction or time
vocabulary.example: In "keep up", up is the preposition.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to lift something from a surface
vocabulary.example: Please pick up your bag from the floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hold something (in your possession, for some time, or in one place)

vocabulary.example: Great job! Keep up the good work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move or learn at the same speed as someone or something
vocabulary.example: He walks fast. I can't keep up with him.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop someone from going to sleep
vocabulary.example: The noise kept me up all night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep something at the same level
vocabulary.example: Try to maintain a good speed.
The keys are in my possession.
A man approached me and asked for directions.
Fix up the old house to improve it.
Prices go up when costs increase.

vocabulary.meaning_en: important news from around the world
vocabulary.example: I read the news to keep up with world events.

fine_lines.title: keep up vs keep up with vs keep someone up
fine_lines.explanation_ar: keep up (the good work) = استمر وحافظ على المستوى. keep up with = جارِ سرعة شخص أو شيء (أو تابِع الأخبار). keep someone up = يمنعه من النوم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: keep up (the good work) = continue, maintain. keep up with = move at the same speed as someone/something (or follow news). keep someone up = stop someone from sleeping.

examples.sentence: Your grades are great. Keep it up!
I read the news to keep up with world events.
The baby kept us up all night.

expressions.example: Your English is getting better. Keep up the good work!
Ten days without sugar? Keep it up!

expressions.meaning_en: Are you able to follow at my speed?
expressions.example: I'm talking fast. Can you keep up?

expressions.phrase: I hope I haven't kept you up.
expressions.meaning_ar: أرجو ألّا أكون قد أبقيتك مستيقظًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Polite: I hope I didn't stop you from sleeping.
expressions.example: Sorry for calling so late. I hope I haven't kept you up.

expressions.meaning_en: Is it hard for you to follow?
expressions.example: So many new apps! Having trouble keeping up?

grammar.title: What is a phrasal verb?
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل المركّب = فعل + حرف جر (أو حرفان). معاً يصنعان معنى جديدًا قد يختلف عن معنى الفعل وحده. الفعل الواحد قد يكون له أكثر من معنى.
grammar.explanation_en: A phrasal verb = verb + preposition (or two). Together they make a new meaning that can be different from the verb alone. One phrasal verb can have several meanings.
examples: pick up: lift something (Pick up the pen.)
keep up: continue (Keep up the good work.)

grammar.title: Work out the meaning: verb + up
grammar.explanation_ar: لفهم فعل مركّب جديد اجمع معنى الفعل مع معنى حرف الجر. keep = الاحتفاظ بشيء (ملكية)، أو لفترة زمنية، أو بمكان/وضع. up = (1) حركة/اتجاه، (2) زيادة، (3) تحسين، (4) توقف/انتهاء، (5) اقتراب.
grammar.explanation_en: To understand a new phrasal verb, combine the verb's meaning with the preposition's meaning. keep = hold something (possession), hold for a time, hold a place/position. up = (1) movement/direction, (2) increase, (3) improve, (4) stop/end, (5) approach.
examples: keep (hold a place) + up (direction) = continue: Keep up the good work.
keep (hold a place) + up (increase speed) = keep up with someone.
keep (hold a position) + up (direction: not lying down) = keep someone up all night.

grammar.title: Meanings of up in other phrasal verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: معاني up تساعدك في أفعال كثيرة: stand up (اتجاه)، speed up (زيادة)، fix up (تحسين)، use up / end up (انتهاء)، come up to someone (اقتراب).
grammar.explanation_en: The meanings of up help with many verbs: stand up (direction), speed up (increase), fix up (improve), use up / end up (finish), come up to someone (approach).
examples: Please speed up. We are late.
They fixed up the old car.
We used up all the milk.
A boy came up to me and said hello.

questions.question: Boss: "Keep up the good work!" means ___.
He runs very fast. I can't ___ him.
questions.explanation_ar: keep up with someone = يجاري سرعته.
questions.explanation_en: Keep up with someone = go at the same speed.

questions.question: "The loud noise kept me up all night." means ___.
questions.explanation_ar: keep someone up = يمنعه من النوم.
questions.explanation_en: Keep someone up = stop someone from sleeping.

questions.question: Which is NOT a meaning of "up" in this lesson?
questions.explanation_ar: معاني up: اتجاه، زيادة، تحسين، انتهاء، اقتراب.
questions.explanation_en: Up: direction, increase, improve, stop/end, approach.

questions.question: "I read the news to keep up with world events." means I want to ___.
"Speed up" uses up with the meaning ___.
"A man came up to me." Here up means ___.
What does "maintain" mean?
choices: to keep at the same level
questions.explanation_en: Maintain = keep at the same level.
